stem: Why was the Battle of Vicksburg a strategic victory in the Civil War?

options.label: A
options.text: The battle opened the way for a full-scale Union attack on Atlanta.

options.label: B
options.text: The battle gave the Union control of the Mississippi River.

options.label: C
options.text: The battle prevented a Confederate invasion of the North.

options.label: D
options.text: The battle allowed President Lincoln to issue the Emancipation Proclamation.
